goal: Allow local RPC clients and bitcoin-cli to connect via UNIX domain sockets instead of TCP loopback
Avoids TCP overhead and lets users control RPC access using standard OS filesystem permissions
agreement: Substantive support for adding UNIX domain socket RPC with previous objections addressed
Concept approval because external projects relying on Core need UNIX socket support (winterrdog)
Awaiting review on pushed fixes for socket collisions and a Host header regression (b-l-u-e)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fulfills a decade-old request to allow UNIX domain sockets for RPC
Local callers avoid TCP loopback overhead and can use standard OS filesystem permissions
Removes the need to configure IP-based access filtering for local-only RPC
